CustomField.description: Length of the period of performance in whole months, calculated from Grant Start Date and Grant End Date. Treats the end date as inclusive, so 10/01/2025 to 09/30/2026 reads 12, not 11. Blank until both dates are set. Formula - not editable.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR(ISBLANK(Grant_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(Grant_End_Date__c)), NULL, ((YEAR(Grant_End_Date__c) - YEAR(Grant_Start_Date__c)) * 12) + (MONTH(Grant_End_Date__c) - MONTH(Grant_Start_Date__c)) + IF(DAY(Grant_End_Date__c) >= DAY(Grant_Start_Date__c), 1, 0) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Period of performance in whole months, from Grant Start Date to Grant End Date. Calculated - fix the dates to change it.
CustomField.label: Grant Length
